desc:
🥤 Run your own cozy drink café!

Take orders from cute customers, then make every drink by hand:
🥛 Pick a cup and pour the base, stop right at the line!
🍓 Pump in the syrup and add boba, jelly or pudding
🌀 Blend it smooth or chunky… or keep the pretty layers
🍦 Swirl on whipped cream and drizzle your favorite sauce
🍪 Top it off with macarons, sprinkles, mini donuts and more
✨ Serve it perfect for big tips!

Level up through 100+ levels to unlock new cups, flavors and toppings: kitty cups, galaxy soda, rainbow glaze and lots more. Discover new recipes, decorate your café, hire staff, and grow your little stand into the cutest shop in town.

New ingredients and seasonal treats added often! 💖
